title: Adaptations of the flat jack test for its application in cob walls
author: Jiménez Rios, O'Dwyer

steps.title: Wallette setting up (single test)
steps.instruction: Place each cob wallettes on a bottom steel pallet, cover with a top steel cap, and attach four steel threaded bars between the pallet and the cap. Manually tighten the bars to impose a total compressive load of 50 kN, measured with a load cell positioned between each nut and its support (a hollow steel piece welded to the flange of the top‑cap UB section). Increase the load in ≈2 kN increments per bar, alternating the tightening order after each increment. The loading of each wallettes takes 15–20 min.

substeps.instruction: Assemble bottom steel pallet and top steel cap on the cob wallettes.
Insert four steel threaded bars through the pallet flanges to the cap.
Tighten bars manually, monitoring load with load cells, to reach 50 kN total.
Apply load in ~2 kN per‑bar increments, alternating which bar is tightened each time.
Allow 15–20 min for the loading process for each wallettes.

steps.title: Control points fixing (single)
steps.instruction: Fix the designated control points on the wallettes as required for displacement measurement.

steps.title: Measure initial control distance (single)
steps.instruction: Measure and record the initial distance between the fixed control points.

steps.title: Slot cutting (single)
steps.instruction: Cut the first slot in the wallettes at the prescribed location using the appropriate cutting tool.

steps.title: Clean slot (single)
steps.instruction: Remove all debris and dust from the freshly cut slot to ensure a clean surface.

steps.title: Cut depth measurement (single)
steps.instruction: Measure and record the depth of the first slot using a calibrated depth gauge.

steps.title: Initial displacements measurement (single)
steps.instruction: Measure any initial displacements of the control points before loading.

steps.title: Hydraulic connection & jack insertion (single)
steps.instruction: Connect the hydraulic system to the test rig and insert the flat jack into the first slot.

steps.title: System purging (single)
steps.instruction: Purge the hydraulic system to remove air bubbles and ensure proper pressure transmission.

steps.title: Apply seating pressure (single)
steps.instruction: Apply the initial seating pressure with the hydraulic jack to bring the jack into firm contact with the slot walls.

steps.title: Remove pressure (single)
steps.instruction: Release the seating pressure completely.

steps.title: Pressure increments (single)
steps.instruction: Increase the hydraulic pressure in predefined increments, recording the corresponding jack displacement at each step.

steps.title: Remove pressure (single)
steps.instruction: After the final increment, fully release the hydraulic pressure.

steps.title: Remove flat jack (single)
steps.instruction: Extract the flat jack from the slot and disconnect the hydraulic system.

steps.title: Wallette setting up (double test)
steps.instruction: Without releasing the previously applied compression, keep the four steel threaded bars tightened as after the single test; the top steel cap continues to support the material above the second cut, preventing failure outside the slot area (as per standard [6]).

steps.title: Second slot cutting
steps.instruction: Cut a second slot in the same wallettes at the designated position for the double flat jack test.

steps.title: Clean second slot
steps.instruction: Remove all debris from the second slot to ensure a clean surface.

steps.title: Second cut depth measurement
steps.instruction: Measure and record the depth of the second slot with a calibrated depth gauge.

steps.title: Control points fixing (double)
steps.instruction: Fix the control points again as required for the double‑jack test.

steps.title: Hydraulic connection & jacks insertion (double)
steps.instruction: Connect the hydraulic system and insert the two flat jacks into the second slot.

steps.title: System purging (double)
steps.instruction: Purge the hydraulic circuit to eliminate air bubbles.

steps.title: Apply seating pressure (double)
steps.instruction: Apply the initial seating pressure with the hydraulic jacks to ensure proper contact with the slot walls.

steps.title: Remove pressure (double)
steps.instruction: Release the seating pressure completely.

steps.title: Measure initial control distance (double)
steps.instruction: Measure and record the distance between control points before pressure increments.

steps.title: Pressure increments (double)
steps.instruction: Increase hydraulic pressure in the predefined increments, recording jack displacement at each step.

steps.title: Remove pressure (double)
steps.instruction: After the final increment, fully release the hydraulic pressure.
